required.estimate: server returns an estimate with an id before dispatch; REFINE and REGENERATE both show cost before the founder commits
required.confirmation: founderConfirmedSpend must travel with spendConfirmationId matching an estimate the founder was shown; the server rejects a confirmation with no matching estimate

required.cancel: in-flight runs are cancellable; a cancelled run records what was actually spent
required.providerFailure: no cost recorded, run marked FAILED
required.receipt: runId, action, tokens or provider units, estimatedUsd, actualUsd, projectId, pageId
required.concurrency: both actions disable while a generation is in flight

eventTaxonomy.lineageRule: refine descends from a parent; regenerate produces a sibling. The payloads carry that distinction so lineage is queryable without re-deriving it.
eventTaxonomy.rule: use these eleven names exactly; add none without a further schema decision

persistenceContract.today: browser localStorage, key site00:design-page-v3-authority:v1 — no Supabase table, no endpoint
persistenceContract.canonicalStore: server, project-scoped row keyed by (projectId, pageId) holding the DesignWorkspaceAuthoritySession
persistenceContract.identity: authority ids unchanged — vma-<viewport>-v<n>-<ts> is already unique and carries lineage
persistenceContract.versioning: monotonic session version column for optimistic concurrency; a write carrying a stale version is rejected, never merged
persistenceContract.history: append-only event log, one row per emitted event, using the eleven-member union; the session row is a projection of the log
persistenceContract.localCache: localStorage becomes an optimistic cache only, invalidated when the server version differs or buildRef differs — the rule recoverDesignPageAuthorityGallery already applies
persistenceContract.migration: first server read adopts the local session if the server has none; thereafter the server wins permanently
